item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-25
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `statcheck` and `escicheck` tools have received important updates, with `statcheck` undergoing administrative updates and `escicheck` being synchronized with `effectcheck` version 0.6.14. Meanwhile, the `oddpub` project has improved its code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed several documentation and test issues, including a rendering fix for affiliation remnants. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker, and `regcheck` has resolved multiple issues, including bugs with the demo page, card preview, and survey routes. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations within our community, and we celebrate the progress being made to enhance these open-source research tools.

11 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
